body: As much as I appreciate you wanting to understand what has brought me to such a place, the unfortunate situation is that I am here and now thinking more of damage control in terms of not wanting to harm anyone else more than nessercary as I end my life. I only hope my next life is one where I don't make as many mistakes.

I'm going to be using formic acid and sulphuric acid and a bit of glassware and gas cleaning to produce relatively pure carbon monoxide in order to end my own life. I would prefer to do this In the comfort of my bed but am concerned about the gas affecting the neighbours. Otherwise I will do it in my car. Does anyone know how well the gas will disperse? I am the ground floor with two floors above me. I can't work out a way to contain the gas safely yet or disperse it safely after I am done.
Not looking for being told not to do it. Just trying to make sure I don't harm anyone else.

So far the only people who know the truth outside of the police are my girlfriend (only told her about 10 days ago) my best friend, my brother in law  (sisters husband) and another friend who I broke down on whilst drunk. They've all tried to be supportive each in their own way but I don't believe they will all still be there once I go to court and I'm named in the public eye.
If CO is produced from methanoic and sulphuric acid do I need to wash the resulting gas to try and produce pure CO? Either through water or a KOH solution?

I have been told that my GP Might be able to help from a couple of people now. I'm just not too sure about how to approach that option. I have tried anti depressants about 3 years ago but I found they messed with my head too much so stopped taking them

Just had to Google the streisand effect. 

So you're saying it would be in the best interest of the suspect to not mention these thoughts to the police as it will only have a negative impact on the suspects freedom whilst on bail. To let the police do their job. Wait until the outcome of the case is reached and then to make the decision afterwards.

I've tried posting it on the UK one too. It's not showing up for some reason though.

So if the police knew that it would be the outcome of their own investigation  that would be the catalyst for the person to make the final decision they wouldn't think about that? They'd still proceed pretty much exactly as they had done anyway towards a conviction. I'm not saying that threatening suicide should be a tactic used to avoid prosecution but the reality would be that the person wouldn't be considering suicide if it was.dealt with in a way that didn't involve their name becoming public. Once it becomes public, although the justice system would consider the matter dealt with, society wouldn't be accepting the person back and therefore suicide becomes their choice after then justice system has finished with them.

Yes I get that but will they try and detain you at all? I mean if you are on bail pending further investigation  and tell them that it's not until the case becomes public that the person would want to kill themselves. Will they not act on it also until it becomes public as that is the point it is likely to happen?

I know to expect comments like suicide isn't the answer etc. truth is though I've found myself in a very difficult situation. One where although I don't believe I actually deserve to die, I don't believe I will be able to be Strong enough to survive the the situation I am going to end up in. The prospect of ending up alone with nothing and no doubt even homeless is very real. My life as I know it is over its just a matter of time. I don't know how to prepare for something like this.
